title: Matt Might - Winning the War on Error Solving the Halting Problem and Curing Cancer
summary: Matt Might's Curry On talk on ending errors in code, both software and the human genome. He covers conservative approximation of the halting problem via static analysis and a computational approach to precision medicine.
why: Recommended as a jaw-dropping, must-see talk that gives an amazing intro to static analysis alongside Might's personal story.

quote.text: If you haven't seen it, Might's talk "Winning the War on Error: Solving the Halting Problem and Curing Cancer" is amazing, a must-see.
